flow_reference.definition: Quantity times sum of fastest eligible per-unit processing time for every sequential operation. Excludes queues, setup, handling, transport, shifts and contention. Not an attained or proven optimum. Valid for the current no-split sequential-route model.

utilization_definitions.service: setup + manual handling + automatic processing; excludes waiting
utilization_definitions.occupied: all non-idle machine states, including waiting for service
utilization_definitions.denominator: calendar minutes in measurement window per machine; excludes drain

resource_diagnostics.setup_wait_definition: Requests whose setup service starts in the measurement window; includes waits begun in warmup, excludes still-pending requests. Not an uncensored all-request mean.
